page.layout: One page of text. Running head centred at the top, page number at the top right. Below it, a block of six Arabic lines, right-aligned. The seventh Arabic line ends with an italic Latin paragraph set in full width. Below that, the gathering signature "Ee" at the foot, centred.

p.l: واحعين لي حكم دير مارون ديو[?]
لان كانت صفة هذا النير علي

main_text.p: واهب قليسين Tunc responderunt Syri; nos redimus ad judiciũ Monasterii Maronis, Monasterii Syrorũ, quod interpretatur domicilium Domini (ex Etymologia nominis id significat) erat ante id Monasterium situm ad ripam Hasi, extra urbem Hemat, eratque numerus illius Monachorum 800. Sanctorum, & paulo infra subditi:

page.notes: The Arabic lines are only partly legible at this scan resolution. Words marked [?] are uncertain, and the letter forms of the first line and the line ending "الوب" may be misread. The Latin is clear. "8oo" is printed with a small-o form that may be a 0 with a stroke; copied as printed. "subditi:" is slightly unclear at the end and marked as printed. The Latin "Syrorũ" and "judiciũ" use the tilde for a left-out m as printed. The running head and page number are read clearly.
